title: Encoder.mlmodelc (parakeet-ultra) takes ~105 s to load on iPhone 18 Pro Max vs. ~12 s on iPhone 16 Pro Max after each app update
body:
Environment
- FluidAudio 0.17.7 (revision 503b4bd), via Swift Package Manager
- Model: AsrModelVersion.ultra (FluidInference/parakeet-ultra-coreml), loaded with AsrModels.downloadAndLoad(version:)
- iOS 27.0.1 (24A446) on both devices
- iPhone 18 Pro Max (chip V64sAP, 11 GB) and iPhone 16 Pro Max (chip D94AP, 7.4 GB)

What happens
After each app install or update, ModelHub.loadModels spends almost all of its time on Encoder.mlmodelc with cpuAndNeuralEngine. On iPhone 18 Pro Max that takes about 105 s, on iPhone 16 Pro Max about 12 s. The other models load in under 100 ms on both devices. Later launches are fast, so this looks like the one-time Neural Engine compilation in Core ML.

iPhone 16 Pro Max (D94AP)
Compiled model Preprocessor.mlmodelc in 37.87 ms      (cpuOnly)
Compiled model Encoder.mlmodelc in 12163.72 ms        (cpuAndNeuralEngine)
Compiled model Decoder.mlmodelc in 82.95 ms
Compiled model JointDecisionv3.mlmodelc in 59.04 ms

iPhone 18 Pro Max (V64sAP)
Compiled model Preprocessor.mlmodelc in 17.76 ms      (cpuOnly)
Compiled model Encoder.mlmodelc in 104816.09 ms       (cpuAndNeuralEngine)
Compiled model Decoder.mlmodelc in 62.44 ms
Compiled model JointDecisionv3.mlmodelc in 39.61 ms

Steps to reproduce
1. Integrate FluidAudio 0.17.7 in an iOS app and load AsrModelVersion.ultra at launch.
2. Install the app on an iPhone 18 Pro Max running iOS 27.0.1 and launch it.
3. Compare the Encoder.mlmodelc load time with an iPhone 16 Pro Max.
4. Reinstall or update the app: the long load happens again.

Expected: Similar or shorter encoder load time on the newer chip.

[CoreML-iPhone16ProMax.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33385080/CoreML-iPhone16ProMax.log)
[CoreML-iPhone18ProMax.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33385081/CoreML-iPhone18ProMax.log)
